scripts.check: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.fix: npm run fix:format && npm run fix:lint
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e-local
scripts.sync-lockfile:frontend: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yaml run --rm frontend-preview npm install
scripts.sync-lockfile:e2e: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yaml run --rm --no-deps e2e-tests npm install
scripts.sync-lockfiles: npm run sync-lockfile:frontend && npm run sync-lockfile:e2e
